leaves.title: Welcome to Quire
leaves.body:
Quire is a **single-file notebook**. Open this file, write, share it — the whole wiki lives inside it.

Try it:

- Click [[Wikilinks]] to follow links between notes.
- Press `⌘K` to find anything by name.
- Press `⌘J` to start a new leaf.
- Press `⌘S` to save your wiki to disk.
- Press `?` anytime to see all keyboard shortcuts.

In Chromium browsers (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc), you'll be prompted once to connect Quire to a file on disk. After that, every change auto-saves silently.

In Firefox and Safari, hit `⌘S` to download the updated HTML — replace your old `quire.html` with it to keep changes permanent.

leaves.title: Wikilinks
leaves.body:
Wrap any phrase in double brackets to link to another note:

`[[Another note]]`

Clicking a wikilink opens the target note in the river beside this one — it doesn't navigate away. Notes accumulate horizontally; you can read three at once.

If the target doesn't exist yet, the link is rendered dim. Click it and Quire creates the leaf for you.

Backlinks are computed automatically — see the panel at the bottom of a leaf when it's focused.

Related: [[Welcome to Quire]]
